detail.longDescription: For the longest time, I've wanted MIDI files created from scans of sheet music to listen to. I can't play the piano myself, but I've been around music since I was a child. The existing software almost never sounded good, never expressive. This is an attempt to use an LLM to create music from BANA Music Braille Code, which has embedded rubato, tempo and dynamics. Gottschalk: Grande Tarantelle, Op. 67 (arr. Nicolás Ruiz Espadero)
